data.name: Fey Wings
data.description: You can grow insectlike wings from your back and become one size category smaller (as if you had used reduce person), gaining a fly speed of 60 feet with average maneuverability. You can maintain this form for %1 minutes. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be used in 1-minute increments. This bloodline power replaces fey magic.
